verses.1: And the LORD said to Moses, “I will still bring about one more disaster upon Pharaoh and Egypt. After that, I will send you away from there.” Just as He sent away all those who were before you, so too will He send away you from there.
verses.2: Speak to the people in their own language. Ask each person from their community, a man or a woman, for gold and silver.
verses.3: And Jehovah showed the kindness of the people to the Egyptians. Even Moses was greatly respected in Egypt, in the eyes of Pharaoh’s servants and in the eyes of the people.
verses.4: And Moses said, “As Jehovah has said, ‘At midnight I will go out through Egypt.’”
verses.5: And all the prisoners in Egypt died. From Pharaoh’s prison, who sat on his throne, down to the prisons of the other prisoners, and all those who were imprisoned among the animals.
verses.6: And there will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt. There has never been such a cry before, and there will never be such a cry again.
verses.7: And all the children of Israel shall not dare to harm any dog or animal, so that they may know what will happen when Jehovah falls between Egypt and Israel.
verses.8: And all your servants came to me and bowed down before me, saying, “Go out, you and all the people who are with you.” Then I went out with Pharaoh’s people.
verses.9: And the LORD said to Moses, “Do not listen to Pharaoh. Otherwise, my wrath will be poured out on Egypt’s land.”
verses.10: And Moses and Aaron did all these miracles before Pharaoh. Then Jehovah strengthened Pharaoh’s heart, and he refused to let the children of Israel leave their land.
